verdict_summary: No legitimate code-control path for the DJI Neo 2: DJI Fly drives it through a private, per-product native stack (ilink transport, per-product protobuf libs, internal UAV key-value SDK) and MSDK v5 does not support the Neo series. Live video IS available via DJI Fly's official RTMP live streaming.

video_paths.notes: Pushed over the phone's internet: 4G/5G in Wi-Fi mode; LAN Wi-Fi when using RC-N3 over USB. ~1-3 s latency.

control_path_summary: On-screen virtual sticks (MviVirtualStickView) or the RC-N3 feed an internal key-value UAV SDK (KeySendVirtualStickFlightControlData, KeyVirtualStickControlModeEnabled), serialised by per-product proto libraries (libwab*_proto.so etc.) over DJI's ilink transport (libilink2, libilink_network, libilink_protobuf) either directly over Wi-Fi to the drone (WifiControlConnectActivity) or over USB-AOA (DJIAoaActivity) to the RC-N3, which relays via O4/OcuSync (UAVOcuSyncKey). Video returns over the same link and is decoded natively (libuav_video_jni, libmtmd_h264streaming). No public MSDK (no dji.sdk classes). Flight safety limits are enforced on the aircraft.
recommended_integration: Fly the Neo 2 manually (labelled piloted) and stream via DJI Fly RTMP into drone/LiveFeedDriver for Decisions API bay checks; run patrol autonomy in SimDriver with the code safety supervisor; Devin mission agent plans missions only. For real autonomy: Ryze Tello EDU (open Wi-Fi SDK) indoors, DJI Mini 4 Pro + MSDK v5 + RC-N3 as the product path.

depth_data.summary: Neo 2 has omnidirectional monocular vision, forward LiDAR and downward infrared ToF. DJI Fly's shared native stack contains per-sector obstacle-distance types (bird-view 'radar' display, warnings) and flight-record obstacle/perception fields; no point cloud or depth map types were found. Neo 2 emission of each field is not verified at runtime.
official_exposure: Live-view obstacle warnings / radar display (UI only)
Possibly fields in the encrypted FlightRecord, readable post-flight only via DJI's official parsing API key
depth_data.sentinel_alternative: Depth from our own COLMAP twin plus monocular estimation on the RTMP video; MSDK v5 perception API on a Mini 4 Pro for real obstacle distances.
